title: Rewards Activity Courtesy Schedule — Overdue Tailwise Plus Fee
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** An activity courtesy — a flat dollar amount — is subtracted from the overdue fee collected to reinstate a past-due Tailwise Plus Annual or Tailwise Plus Premier Annual membership, according to the points-earning entries on the membership's rewards ledger dated in the last 12 months.

| Points-earning entries dated in the last 12 months | Activity courtesy |
|---|---|
| 15 or more | $3.00 |
| 8 to 14 | $1.50 |
| fewer than 8 | none |

Only points-earning entries count; bonus entries, reversals and certificate entries are not points-earning entries.

**Edges (hypothetical).** 7 entries: none. 8: $1.50. 14: $1.50. 15: $3.00.
